 Order

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the petitioners has filed an application seeking leave of this Court for compounding of offences along with the affidavits.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners and respondent No.2 in unison submit that the parties have settled their dispute among themselves.

The settlement insofar as it concerns the present lis in support of an affidavit filed by respondent No.2, reads as follows:
NC: 2024:KHC:19232 " AFFIDAVIT I Smt Afrin Banu D/o Azeem w/o Thousif aged about 26 years, R/of Mathrushree Building, 2nd Flor, Madooru, kotekar post,
Mangaluru Taluk Mangaluru District - 5750019, do hereby solemnly affirm and state on oath as follows:
1. I state that I am the 2nd respondent in the above case and I know the facts and circumstances of the case and as such I am deposing as hereunder.
2. I state that, myself and 1st respondent entered into a deed of mutual divorce and signed the deed by dissolving our marriage.
3. I state that, I agreed to withdraw the criminal case in crime No.99/2021 and signed the deed in the presence of witnesses.
4. I state that, after obtaining the divorce from 1st petitioner got married again.
5. I state that, I have no objection to quash the proceedings against the petitioners .
What is stated above are true and correct to the best of my knowledge and belief.
4. In the light of the settlement arrived at between the parties and the offences not being against the State, I deem it appropriate to accept the application seeking compounding of the offence and quash the proceedings, qua the petitioners.
NC: 2024:KHC:19232 5.

For the aforesaid reasons, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) The criminal petition is disposed.
(ii) The proceedings in C.C.No.1577/2022, on the file of JMFC, III Court, Mangaluru of Mangaluru Women's Police Station, Dakshina Kannada District, stands quashed.
